title: Wise: expressive numerical utility
summary: Pair confident display scale with a dominant transaction amount and adjacent, reconciled costs and terms.
use_when: A practical consumer calculator or pricing decision needs both a memorable public voice and explicit economics.
avoid_when: A quiet reading environment or a many-column operator comparison needs lower expressive emphasis.
